admission.justification: Location-omitted shorts measuring within bound is proved by the named passing guard case; single-file member of the family.

applicability: Every short form whose detail location does not fit or could not be written.
conditions: The detail file is written all the same when writable.
The fixed no-path sentence names today's tool-log line as the lookup.
When the detail file cannot be written, the answer carries the caller's logError with resultKept false.
exclusions: Locations that fit, which ride as log.
statement: An over-budget location is never cut, substituted or capped: the answer carries the fixed no-path logError and no log while the detail file is written all the same; when the detail file cannot be written the answer carries the caller's logError with resultKept false.
